text:
Little Joys Dental Clinic is a dental clinic that accepts the Gold Card and Social Security. I've visited them 3 times to gather details before writing this review 😄😆
It's a private clinic close to home with excellent service and treatment.
What I really liked was the precise scheduling of appointments. I didn't have to wait for a long time like at some other clinics where I paid out of pocket and still had to wait for 1-2 hours.
With the Gold Card, I can get dental treatment at the clinic 3 times a year without any cost or extra charges.
1. Scaling
2. Filling
3. Tooth extraction
4. Sealant
5. Fluoride treatment
6. Full mouth check-up
...Located opposite Makro Lad Saway.
